description: Fixed, independently authored policy-source and complete-condition expectations. These questions are evaluation inputs only, never production routing rules.
approval_limit: Supplied synthetic source files have no authoritative approval, version or effective-date registry.

questions.question: How many PTO hours can I carry over?

required_passages.text: Unused PTO carries over up to 40 hours into the next calendar year
Carryover balances above 40 hours are forfeited unless local law requires payout

questions.source_rationale: PTO / Accrual states both the cap and the local-law exception.

questions.question: Does my unused paid time off roll into next year?

required_passages.text: Unused PTO carries over up to 40 hours into the next calendar year
Carryover balances above 40 hours are forfeited unless local law requires payout

questions.source_rationale: Paid time off is the source title; rollover is governed by its Accrual clauses.

questions.question: How much unused vacation can I keep for next year?

required_passages.text: Unused PTO carries over up to 40 hours into the next calendar year
Carryover balances above 40 hours are forfeited unless local law requires payout

questions.source_rationale: Vacation here is a plain-language synonym for paid time off; this tests vocabulary, not a personal balance.

questions.question: Does PTO over 40 hours expire, and are there exceptions?

required_passages.text: Unused PTO carries over up to 40 hours into the next calendar year
Carryover balances above 40 hours are forfeited unless local law requires payout

questions.source_rationale: The forfeiture provision cannot be separated from its local-law qualification.

questions.question: How far in advance must I request PTO, and who approves it?

required_passages.text: Submit requests through Workday at least 2 weeks in advance for planned time off
Manager approval is required before time off is confirmed

questions.source_rationale: PTO / Requesting Time Off gives notice and approval conditions.

questions.question: Can I relocate to another state while working remotely?

required_passages.text:
Employees must notify HR before relocating, since it can affect payroll
  tax withholding, benefits eligibility, and compensation zone
Roles designated remote-eligible may work from an approved US Zone

questions.source_rationale: Remote Work / Eligible Roles and Location Changes contain the available conditions; no automatic approval is inferred.

questions.question: Do I need to tell HR before moving to another state?

required_passages.text:
Employees must notify HR before relocating, since it can affect payroll
  tax withholding, benefits eligibility, and compensation zone

questions.source_rationale: The only source-authored relocation instruction is in Remote Work / Location Changes.

questions.question: I work from home. Who should I tell before I change my work location?

required_passages.text:
Employees must notify HR before relocating, since it can affect payroll
  tax withholding, benefits eligibility, and compensation zone
Roles designated remote-eligible may work from an approved US Zone

questions.source_rationale: Work from home maps to remote work; Location Changes and Eligible Roles are relevant.

questions.question: Which roles can work remotely and from what approved zone?

required_passages.text: Roles designated remote-eligible may work from an approved US Zone

questions.source_rationale: Remote Work / Eligible Roles specifies remote eligibility and an approved US Zone.

questions.question: When do I need an itemized receipt for an expense reimbursement?

required_passages.text: Submit expenses within 30 days of the expense date
Include an itemized receipt for any expense over $25

questions.source_rationale: Expense / Submission sets the receipt threshold and submission timing.

questions.question: My submitted expense was rejected. How long do I have to appeal?

required_passages.text:
If a submitted expense is rejected, the employee can appeal to their
  manager and People Ops within 14 days of the rejection

questions.source_rationale: Expense / Disputes supplies the appeal recipients and deadline.

questions.question: When does health coverage begin after I am hired?

required_passages.text:
Medical, dental, and vision plans are available starting the first day of
  the month following hire date

questions.source_rationale: Benefits / Health Coverage gives a date rule rather than a personal enrollment decision.

questions.question: When am I eligible for the retirement company match?

required_passages.text: 401(k) with company match is available after 90 days of employment

questions.source_rationale: Benefits / Retirement is the only retirement-match provision.

questions.question: Does medical leave after one year have an hours requirement?

required_passages.text:
Employees become eligible for protected leave after 12 months of employment
  and 1,250 hours worked in the prior 12 months (or per local law, whichever
  is more generous)

Always route eligibility determinations through an HR partner - do not
  confirm eligibility informally

questions.source_rationale: Leave of Absence / Eligibility and Job Protection preserve hours, time, local-law qualification and HR determination.

questions.question: How many weeks of parental leave can a non-birthing parent take?

required_passages.text:
All full-time employees are eligible for parental leave regardless of
  tenure, for birth, adoption, or foster placement
Non-birthing parents: up to 8 weeks paid leave

questions.source_rationale: Parental Leave / Eligibility and Duration contain the applicable general conditions.

questions.question: How can I anonymously report harassment without retaliation?

required_passages.text:
Employees can report concerns to their manager, HR partner, or through the
  confidential ethics reporting line, including anonymously

Retaliation against anyone who reports in good faith, or who participates
  in an investigation, is strictly prohibited and will result in discipline

questions.source_rationale: Harassment reporting covers anonymity; the Code of Conduct is separately acceptable for its non-retaliation provision.

questions.question: Will medical documentation for a workplace accommodation be kept confidential?

required_passages.text:
Medical documentation may be requested but is handled confidentially and
  stored separately from the employee's general personnel file

questions.source_rationale: Workplace Accommodation / Interactive Process specifies documentation handling.

questions.question: How much PTO carries over, and must I tell HR before moving states for remote work?

required_passages.text: Unused PTO carries over up to 40 hours into the next calendar year
Carryover balances above 40 hours are forfeited unless local law requires payout

Employees must notify HR before relocating, since it can affect payroll
  tax withholding, benefits eligibility, and compensation zone
Roles designated remote-eligible may work from an approved US Zone

questions.source_rationale: The two independent clauses require PTO and Remote Work sources.

questions.question: As a new hire, when do I receive a laptop for remote work?

required_passages.text: New hires receive a laptop and standard peripherals within the first week

questions.source_rationale: Remote Work / Equipment contains the laptop rule; unrelated new-hire benefit enrollment is not the requested subject.

questions.question: Can I bring an iguana to the office?
questions.source_rationale: None of the nine supplied policies addresses office pets.

questions.question: Does the company provide pet insurance benefits?
questions.source_rationale: Benefits lists medical, dental, vision and retirement; it contains no pet-insurance provision.

questions.question: Does my manager reimburse relocation expenses?
questions.source_rationale: Expenses describes submission, ordinary travel and disputes; Remote Work requires relocation notice. Neither establishes relocation reimbursement.

questions.question: Do I get bereavement leave?
questions.source_rationale: No supplied source establishes bereavement leave; shared leave headings are insufficient evidence.
